calls.statement:
SELECT 
  sale_date,
  SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
  AND sale_date >= '2025-12-15'
  AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) as earliest_date,
  MAX(sale_date) as latest_date,
  COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT 
  channel_code,
  MIN(sale_date) as earliest_date,
  MAX(sale_date) as latest_date
FROM fact_sales_line
GROUP BY channel_code
ORDER BY channel_code

SELECT 
  sale_date,
  channel_code,
  channel_id,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-12-15' AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date, channel_code, channel_id
ORDER BY sale_date, channel_code

SELECT 
  channel_id,
  channel_name,
  channel_group,
  legacy_channel_code
FROM dim_channel
ORDER BY channel_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  sale_date,
  SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE (channel_id = 2 OR channel_id = 3)
  AND sale_date >= '2025-12-15'
  AND sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  c.channel_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE c.channel_group = 'web'
  AND f.sale_date >= '2025-12-15'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY f.sale_date, c.channel_name
ORDER BY f.sale_date, c.channel_name
